caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with a light brown finish and prominent grain patterns. The cabinet is rectangular in shape and has three distinct sections: the upper section consists of four paneled cupboard doors, two on the left and two on the right, each with simple hinges and small round handles in a metallic color; the lower section is composed of eight large drawers arranged in two vertical columns with four rows each, all featuring round, wooden knobs for handles. The cabinet rests directly on the floor and has a decorative, slightly protruding molding along the top and bottom edges. The composition is straightforward, showing the cabinet against a plain, beige background, with no additional objects present in the drawing.
title: Shaker Cabinet
